primary_scientific_goal: Discover explanatory laws of information, computation and generated behavior in video FFNs, and/or methods that preserve or improve full-generation quality at lower measured physical cost. Information/representation, function/dynamics and computation/execution are parallel mutually informing research entries; causal function localization is one scientific route, not a prerequisite for operator, coding or systems innovation.
scientific_questions: Q1 Information existence: which inputs/state already available before a Wan FFN/block can predict local compute or downstream decision value? Separate deterministic local FFN activation (fully specified by post-Q1 q and weights) from residual/attention-dependent future effects.

Q2 Decision usability: which incremental signals improve cost-adjusted action choice over the best matched static policy after accounting for observation, memory, selector, packing and hardware costs? Use conditional action regret/NetVOI rather than hidden R2 or MI alone.

Q3 Computation necessity: which actual native FFN operations can be omitted or transformed with a favorable real FFN/generation time versus free-running four-step I2V video-quality Pareto, including native QDQ/GELU/gate/residual propagation?

target_mechanism.policy: Explore native algebraic structure, available pre-FFN state and downstream causal response as mutually informative starts. An operator-first construction can reveal which signals matter; an information-first observation can suggest an execution unit. Derive testable equations, real compute savings and meaningful cost-matched comparisons without privileging restoration, R256, SVD, any fixed grouping, or dynamic routing.
target_mechanism.timing_requirement: No universal pre-W1 action-selection requirement. Record actual decision point and available signals; later routing is valid if previously paid computation is reused and total measured work still decreases. For a specifically claimed pre-W1 design, forbid post-W1 oracle leakage. Charge all GEMMs, QDQ, layout, selectors, correction and completion only when actually performed.
necessary_comparators: Full Dense D-Q as fidelity/reference and complete compute baseline
Strongest cost-matched direct low-compute/no-recovery fixed operator under the same conditions
Best existing same-deployment matched FFN baseline (UB1 if suitable; do not force its compensation into another algorithm)
Closest adapted published approach including actual operator/quality/latency assumptions
Optional compensation/dense completion as charged ablation only when the new operator uses or tests it
target_mechanism.formal_distinction: Action choice and method family are not fixed by available Dense/UB1 labels. Local restoration oracle results do not bound other direct sparse, merged or conditional operators. A dynamic claim requires runtime-conditioned action selection; a static winner may still be a useful cost-quality baseline.

existing_joint_acceptance.quality_population: Genuinely new, overlap/hash-audited frozen I2V sources, native free-running four-step sparse student trajectories, same D-Q control and prescribed official metric implementation
existing_joint_acceptance.cost_scope: Original complete FFN boundary including native preparation, activation and weight QDQ, dense/sparse GEMMs, GELU, routing/predictor, R256 or other corrections, layout, gate and residual writeback
existing_joint_acceptance.interpretation: The fixed numeric values 0.5, 1.5 and 0.02 remain exactly as historical registered protocol thresholds. New research is guided by competitive, matched-setting quality-speed Pareto results per research_evaluation_policy; crossing these old numbers is neither necessary nor sufficient for a new paper-quality method. This change never retroactively updates any closed method, protocol or logged result.
existing_joint_acceptance.scope: Historical registered / jointly preregistered project acceptance vector only. Applicable as originally frozen for those historical evaluations; not a universal scientific admission, promotion or publication threshold for new methods after the user's 2026-10-22 clarification.

next_cheapest_mechanism_checks: With all CPU/GPU/model experiments paused, inspect only source, existing evidence and mathematical structure pertinent to the information→decision→compute question.

Separate known deterministic post-Q1 hidden prediction from residual/attention-dependent finite downstream action value; identify which decision-time signals were actually captured versus missing in old OP2/R17 records.

Form competing mechanisms and one decision-changing proof/observation; derive conditional action preference and economic NetVOI for a specific feasible action family, not a generic Dense−UB1 restoration label.

Only after explicit experimental resumption: inspect same-prefix complete native action outcomes, matched best static policies and readout/operator costs; candidate free-running four-step videos and genuine FFN/end-to-end timing are final evidence.
training_policy: Prefer no large retraining; any small post-training is a means to enable deployable dynamic sparsity and must pay its inference overhead. Do not silently redefine the project as full-model distillation or static teacher-flow reconstruction.
guardrail: User's 2026-10-22 clarification changes only the OPEN research evaluation priority: equal-condition competitive evidence and useful quality-speed Pareto improvements outrank the older arbitrary global numeric values. Previously registered protocols/results/rejections remain immutable. No new model execution authority.

research_evaluation_policy.authority: User's updated project-level goal: the previous 50% main-MAC, 1.5x full-FFN and 2% per-axis quality loss were illustrative estimates, not universal conditions for exploring, advancing or publishing NEW methods. Previously preregistered frozen trials retain their original criteria/results; this update does not retroactively change them.
research_evaluation_policy.goal: Discover a competitive, publishable, quality-preserving post-training dynamic FFN method that delivers real hardware acceleration on the four-step Wan student, outperforming the strongest reproducible comparable static/dynamic/prior-art approaches under matched assumptions or demonstrating a credible quality-speed Pareto advance.
comparators: Dense D-Q for absolute fidelity and hardware throughput
Frozen UB1 as historical engineering comparator
Strongest relevant fixed or static method optimized for the same hardware/precision/inference configuration
Closest published dynamic/sparse/FFN/pruning/cache/merge method whose source and adaptation are credible, with training-budget differences stated
Within a method family, strongest matched-compute and matched-quality versions rather than one arbitrary sparsity ratio
comparison_axes: Independent free-running I2V aesthetic, imaging, motion and any visible temporal instability; no proxy-only quality claim
Complete native FFN latency including QDQ, selectors, layouts, corrections, gate/writeback; whole-pipeline generation wall time, GPU memory and operator kernel resources
Actual main-GEMM MAC and total extra physical computation, bandwidth and peak VRAM
Extra post-training compute, data and wall time, not just inference
Reproducibility across sources/seeds and statistical uncertainty of paired quality/performance
fair_comparison_requirements: Same frozen source set and image/prompt/seed manifest for paired evaluation, with genuinely fresh final holdout
Same I2V architecture/checkpoint, denoising schedule, number of steps, resolution and frames where feasible
Same hardware and software environment for actual speed claims, report precision and native HiF4 numerical regime

When prior work differs in model/LoRA/teacher-vs-student/training budget or GPU, state the differences and compare reproducible adapted baselines or normalized matched regimes; do NOT call a cross-regime ratio a head-to-head win
Show both iso-quality speed and iso-cost quality comparisons when feasible, plus complete Pareto curve across operating points
Prefer prospective candidate evaluations and fixed final evaluation to post-hoc selected best-source/oracle numbers
research_evaluation_policy.decision_policy: Choose tests by expected scientific and competitive value, not by whether a prototype crosses an illustrative 50%/1.5x/2% line. A 1.35x measured prototype can be promising if quality, end-to-end efficiency, or unique function/operator geometry beats best comparable baselines or creates a real Pareto improvement; a 1.6x proxy without new-source video quality may be unusable. Pursue mathematical or kernel optimizations when they change actual construction, not merely to tune across the old threshold.
research_evaluation_policy.novelty_policy: Do not claim novelty from router, width schedule, spatial merge, normalization fusion, a speed scalar or a rebranded identity. Independently audit closest literature and demonstrate a distinct compute/information/operator mechanism or experimental effect with paired baselines.
research_evaluation_policy.historical_protocol_precedence: An immutable, individually registered experiment remains judged by its own frozen thresholds, exact version, data and outcomes; a new evaluation policy is not permission to rerun a closed branch or silently change its win condition.
research_evaluation_policy.execution_authorization: This is only research guidance. No new model job, budget, experiment registration, or GitHub workflow run beyond this integration is authorized by this change.

candidate_full_rollout_policy.trigger: After a candidate operator/method is supported sufficiently to select it as a method worth continuing toward deployment/paper evaluation, and before calling it a viable benchmark candidate or verified video method.
candidate_full_rollout_policy.mandatory_minimum: At least one real full four-step student free-running I2V generation, with candidate executing at intended native FFN sites, no dense D-Q reset between steps, video decoded and visually compared against same-input same-seed same-configuration dense D-Q baseline.
candidate_full_rollout_policy.on_quality_collapse: Mark the concrete candidate as ROLLOUT_FAILED_QUALITY, report evidence/time intervals, and do not promote it. Derive a genuinely changed variant if worthwhile; no sample cherry-picking.
candidate_full_rollout_policy.on_inconclusive: Do not promote; retain awaiting review or repair the observation/record.
candidate_full_rollout_policy.after_single_pass: ROLLOUT_PASSED_SMOKE only: not independent official-quality success or Pareto superiority. Evaluate diverse fresh free-running sources and real speed subsequently.
candidate_full_rollout_policy.exploratory_scope: No restriction on math, source, CPU or local diagnostic exploration before method selection; this is a candidate-promotion/claim gate, not a ban on novel hypotheses.
candidate_full_rollout_policy.execution_authorization: Separate explicit user authorization, frozen scoped protocol and model/GPU execution authority remain mandatory; this candidate-smoke policy never self-authorizes jobs or reopens historical closed methods.
candidate_full_rollout_policy.history: All existing R4/R12 D0/R14N0 result closure and preregistered historical thresholds stay as recorded. No method eligibility change.
